answer: In a market for raven illustrations, dune maps, and ivory replicas, agents receive work only in proportion to escrowed stake, which stays locked until each contract's dispute window closes. A verifiable breach forfeits the assigned stake to the customer. Splitting one stake across a thousand identities earns no extra work or voting weight, so a sybil attacker must lock additional capital for additional influence and risks losing it when cheating is proved.
